description: The overflow menu's language action opens a compact picker. "The trigger" is ".chat-overflow-menu-wrapper .btn-icon"; "the popover" is ".chat-overflow-popover"; "the dialog" is the element with role="dialog" that contains a ".language-picker-modal" ("[role=dialog]:has(.language-picker-modal)"). Accessible names here: the popover's language action is a plain button whose name is its text, "Change Language" followed by the current language's name (in a ".overflow-menu-language" span); the dialog's name is the text of the element its aria-labelledby refers to (its ".modal-title"); each option is a ".language-picker-option" button whose name is its text minus an aria-hidden flag span, i.e. the text of its other span (such as "English" or "日本語"). Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new and click the trigger. 2. "The action" is the popover's button whose accessible name contains "Change Language". Its class attribute must be exactly "overflow-menu-item" (nothing else), it should contain the text "English", it must contain no element with role "combobox" (count 0), and its bounding box height must be <= 48. 3. Click the action. 4. The popover should be hidden. The dialog's accessible name should be exactly "Change Language". The dialog should hold exactly one button with aria-pressed="true", and its accessible name must be exactly "English". 5. The buttons inside the dialog's element with role "group" and accessible name exactly "Language" ("the options") should number exactly 9. Scroll the last option into view if needed: it must then lie inside the viewport. 6. The dialog's bounding box must lie inside the viewport: x >= 0, y >= 0, x + width <= {{W}}, y + height <= {{H}}. 7. Click the dialog's button named exactly "日本語". 8. The dialog should be hidden, the trigger must be document.activeElement, and localStorage "shelley-locale" must be exactly "ja". 9. Click the trigger: an element in the popover whose text is exactly "外観" should be visible. 10. Click the popover's button whose accessible name contains "言語を切り替える". 11. The dialog's only button with aria-pressed="true" must have the accessible name exactly "日本語". 12. Click the dialog's button named exactly "English". 13. Reload by navigating to /new again and click the trigger. 14. The popover's button whose accessible name contains "Change Language" should contain the text "English".
